Do not report vulnerabilities here; follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/thebookoftheway3/project-live/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Never attach health records, identifiable recordings or secrets.

## Observation and expected behaviour
What happened, and what did you expect? Plain language is welcome.

## Synthetic reproduction
Commit/version, environment, steps and minimal synthetic input. Include sanitized errors.

## Impact and uncertainty
Who or what is affected? Separate what you observed from your interpretation. Unknowns are welcome.
